item_description_text:
Track 1:
A wristwatch is a small clock with straps that can be worn on the wrist. Watches are great tools that help people keep track of time wherever they are.
Like clocks, watches can be analog or digital. Inside an analog watch, small gears and springs move the hands. You can turn a small knob on the side to move the hands to the correct time. With a digital watch, which is powered by a battery, you press buttons to change the numbers displayed on the screen.
item_description_audio_link:
People invented clocks in Egypt and Babylon more than 3000 years ago and pocket watches in Germany more than 500 years ago. Wristwatches followed soon after. One early example comes from about 450 years ago, when a wealthy man - who was not a known watch maker - wanted to marry the queen of England, and gifted her a wristwatch. 
Today, some watches can measure and show your heartbeat, how much you exercise, and how much you sleep. And with smartwatches, people can share text messages or make phone calls. There are watches designed for sports, health, science, art, and so much more!
